ValidationRule.description: Work Address is editable by the selected users only when the WFH/Virtual checkbox is true.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED( sked_Work_Address_1__c), ISCHANGED( sked_Work_Address_2__c), ISCHANGED( sked_Work_Address_3__c), ISCHANGED( sked_Work_City__c), ISCHANGED( sked_Work_Country__c), ISCHANGED(sked_Work_State__c), ISCHANGED(sked_Work_Zip_Code__c) ), OR( AND( (sked_Virtual_WFH__c != false), ($Profile.Name != 'System Administrator'), ($Profile.Name != 'APS Admin'), ($Profile.Name != 'APS Management'), ($Profile.Name != 'APS Planner'), ($Profile.Name != 'APS Scheduler'), ($Profile.Name != 'Global Admin'), ($Profile.Name != 'Informatica Integration Users') ), AND( (sked_Virtual_WFH__c != true), ($Profile.Name != 'System Administrator'), ($Profile.Name != 'Global Admin'), ($Profile.Name != 'Informatica Integration Users') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only APS Users, Informatica Integration Users, Global Admin and System Admin can edit Work Address when WFH/Virtual Field is set.
